item.title: Boards — Orange Pi RV2 (Ky X1)
item.description: 8-core 64-bit RISC-V (single-core performance about 1.3× a Cortex-A55), 2 TOPS fused CPU compute (no dedicated NPU); 2/4/8GB LPDDR4X; optional 16–128GB eMMC module; 2× M.2 M-Key (PCIe2.0 x2, NVMe capable), 2× GbE, WiFi5/BT5, 3× USB3 + 2× USB2, HDMI, 89×56mm
